bio: A restaurant-asador with a classic feel where you can enjoy meticulously prepared traditional cuisine. It features a pleasant summer terrace, bar space (note the impressive glass-fronted bodega and fresh fish and seafood display counter) and dining room. The à la carte, which specialises in dishes roasted in a wood-fired oven (baby lamb, Castillian-style suckling pig etc), also features enticing starters, stews and superb fish (including Cantabrian hake, “estuary” sea bass, and red tuna tataki)....
